messages:
Celeste: Hey team — quick heads-up: three totally unrelated things happened this weekend and I am SHOCKED in the best way. promoted to Senior PM 🎉, baby due in August 🤰, and we rescued a tiny kitten (meet Miso) 🐱. Sorry for the triple-drop in #random but I needed to tell someone. ❤️
Sam: OMG CONGRATS!!! :tada: :tada: That's wild in the best way. celebration potluck??
Kate: Celeste!!! so many congrats. pics?? we require pics. :pleading_face: Also can I contribute a tiny baby onesie as a celebratory bribe for the kitten?
Ben: Huge congrats!! Potluck definitely. Friday lunchtime works? I can grab paper plates/utensils.
Rita: Potluck yes — I’ll bring dumplings 🥟. Vegetarian options ok?
Maya: Cake poll: chocolate, lemon, or matcha? I vote matcha. :matcha:
Anil: congrats congrats congrats. If you have a registry/link toss it here and folks can chip in for a gift card. Also happy to help with any admin/leave prep.
Oliver: Baby name game: react with :one: for Junie, :two: for Arlo, :three: for Theo. Also kitten name is perfect (Miso) — that’s adorable.
Connie: Kitten adoption tip: slow introductions to new furniture, keep a small safe room at first, and schedule a first vet check within a week. I can DM vet recs.
HR-Bot: Congrats, Celeste! Please remember to submit your parental leave estimate here: https://intranet.redwood/hr/leave and update your manager in PeopleOps.
Celeste: THANK YOU ALL!! Here’s the registry link: https://tinyurl.com/celeste-baby (feel free to skip if you're busy — your vibes are enough). Photo of Miso: I'll post in #random-photos after lunch. Friday potluck at 12:00 in kitchen works for me.
Sam: Signed up for fries and napkins. :thumbsup:
Ben: I'll reserve the kitchen table and bring extra chairs. Balloons? :balloon:
Kate: I’ll bring a card + small gift. RSVP yes.
Rita: RSVP yes, and vegetarian dumplings confirmed.
Maya: I can bring matcha cake if you want — will bake vegan option too.
Anil: I'll chip in for a gift card, can coordinate with others.
Oliver: Reacted with :two: for Arlo. also — kitten advice noted, thanks Connie.
Connie: Happy to help with the vet list. Cooler heads: also post a quick note with any allergies for potluck.
Celeste: added an allergies note in the thread: no shellfish for me! thanks everyone, honestly feeling very loved. ❤️
Sam: PARTY. so proud of you, Celeste!! :sparkles: 
HR-Bot: Friendly reminder: office potluck cleanup rota — please leave kitchen better than you found it.
